data.name: Kuber
data.gender_notes: Kuber is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit kubera, the god of wealth. Its root is Sanskrit kubera (कुबेर). Kubera, the Hindu god of wealth. Kuber is a Sanskrit name meaning “Wealth; the god of wealth”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kuber expresses “Wealth; the god of wealth”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit kubera, the god of wealth.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kuber total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
